definitions: A town in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea.
A former psychiatric hospital in Gonjiam-eup, Gwangju, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, known for its reputation as a haunted location.
A 2018 South Korean horror film directed by Jung Bum-shik, set in the abandoned Gonjiam Psychiatric Hospital.
examples: Gonjiam is a popular destination for thrill-seekers.
The film Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum was a box office success.
She visited Gonjiam during her trip to South Korea.
